examples.chinese: 我後天要到這家飯店去看朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hòutiān yào dào zhè jiā fàndiàn qù kàn péngyǒu.
examples.english: The day after tomorrow I am going to this hotel to see a friend.

examples.chinese: 我們下午四點要到天美飯店，她在那裡等我們。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiàwǔ sì diǎn yào dào Tiānměi Fàndiàn, tā zài nàli děng wǒmen.
examples.english: We have to arrive at Tianmei Hotel at 4 in the afternoon. She will wait for us there.

examples.chinese: 聽說那家飯店不遠，我想我們可以從學校走路去。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō nà jiā fàndiàn bù yuǎn, wǒ xiǎng wǒmen kěyǐ cóng xuéxiào zǒulù qù.
examples.english: I heard that the hotel is not far; I think we can go there from the school on foot.

examples.chinese: 友美，妳看，天美飯店在大學路。我現在知道怎麼走了。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuměi, nǐ kàn, Tiānměi Fàndiàn zài Dàxué Lù. Wǒ xiànzài zhīdào zěnme zǒu le.
examples.english: Look, Youmei. Tianmei Hotel is on Daxue Road. Now I know how to get there.

examples.chinese: （看地圖）啊！天美飯店在這裡！我知道這個地方，附近有郵局跟超級市場。
examples.pinyin: (Kàn dìtú) A! Tiānměi Fàndiàn zài zhèlǐ! Wǒ zhīdào zhè ge dìfang, fùjìn yǒu yóujú gēn chāojíshìchǎng.
examples.english: (Looking at the map) Ah! So here is Tianmei Hotel! I know this place. There is a post office and a supermarket nearby.

examples.chinese: 這家飯店又方便又乾淨，而且不貴。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā fàndiàn yòu fāngbiàn yòu gānjìng, érqiě bú guì.
examples.english: This hotel is both convenient and clean, and moreover not expensive.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"我父母這個週末都不在家，家裡只剩下我一個人。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"我已經把衣服洗完了，剩下的家事請你做。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Wǒ fùmǔ zhège zhōumò dōu bù zài jiā, jiālǐ zhǐ shèngxià wǒ yī ge rén. Wǒ yǐjīng bǎ yīfu xǐ wán le, shèngxià de jiāshì qǐng nǐ zuò.
examples.english: My parents are both not at home this weekend; only I am left at home. I have already finished washing the clothes; please do the remaining housework.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"同事都走了，只剩下他一個人還在做事。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"他是廣告公司的經理，每天要做好多事，忙得不得了。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Tóngshì dōu zǒu le, zhǐ shèngxià tā yí ge rén hái zài zuòshì. Tā shì guǎnggào gōngsī de jīnglǐ, měitiān yào zuò hǎo duō shì, máng de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: The colleagues have all left; only he is left still working. He is a manager at an advertising company; every day he has to do a lot of work and is incredibly busy.

examples.chinese: 剩下的飯菜加熱太多次，就沒什麼營養了，最好每餐都吃光。
examples.pinyin: Shèngxià de fàncài jiārè tài duō cì, jiù méi shénme yíngyǎng le, zuìhǎo měi cān dōu chī guāng.
examples.english: If leftover food is heated too many times, it loses its nutrition; it's best to finish it all at each meal.

examples.chinese: 在那場車禍中，那個孩子失去了父母，家裡只剩下他一個人，大家都很同情他。
examples.pinyin: Zài nà chǎng chēhuò zhōng, nàge háizi shīqù le fùmǔ, jiālǐ zhǐ shèng xià tā yī ge rén, dàjiā dōu hěn tóngqíng tā.
examples.english: In that car accident, that child lost his parents, and he was the only one left in the family; everyone sympathized with him.

examples.chinese: 太太：你喝醉了，別再喝了。 先生：好啦，好啦，還剩下一口，喝完就不喝了。
examples.pinyin: Tàitai: Nǐ hē zuì le, bié zài hē le. Xiānsheng: Hǎo la, hǎo la, hái shèngxià yī kǒu, hē wán jiù bù hē le.
examples.english: Wife: You're drunk; don't drink anymore. Husband: Okay, okay, there's still one sip left; after I finish it, I won't drink anymore.

examples.chinese: 想當年，出國留學的日子雖然很忙，卻很充實。算算日子，剩下兩個星期經理就要退休了。明天是我父母結婚三十年的重要日子，一定要好好地慶祝。
examples.pinyin: 1. Xiǎng dāngnián, chūguó liúxué de rìzi suīrán hěn máng, què hěn chōngshí. 2. Suàn suàn rìzi, shèngxià liǎng ge xīngqī jīnglǐ jiù yào tuìxiū le. 3. Míngtiān shì wǒ fùmǔ jiéhūn sānshí nián de zhòngyào rìzi, yídìng yào hǎohǎo de qìngzhù.
examples.english: 1. Thinking back to those days, although the days of studying abroad were busy, they were very fulfilling. 2. Counting the days, there are only two weeks left before the manager retires. 3. Tomorrow is the important day of my parents' thirtieth wedding anniversary; we must celebrate it well.

examples.chinese: 付完學費，我的獎學金只剩下三千塊，這個月只有吃饅頭過日子了。
examples.pinyin: Fù wán xuéfèi, wǒ de jiǎngxuéjīn zhǐ shèng xià sānqiān kuài, zhège yuè zhǐyǒu chī mántou guò rìzi le.
examples.english: After paying the tuition, I only have 3000 dollars of my scholarship left; this month I can only live on steamed buns.

examples.chinese: 我種了一些瓜，賣了五分之四，剩下的就全送人了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhòng le yīxiē guā, mài le wǔ fēn zhī sì, shèngxià de jiù quán sòng rén le.
examples.english: I grew some melons and sold four-fifths of them; the rest I gave all away.

examples.chinese: 路上安裝紅綠燈，是要保障民眾的交通安全。
examples.pinyin: Lùshàng ānzhuāng hónglǜdēng, shì yào bǎozhàng mínzhòng de jiāotōng ānquán.
examples.english: Installing traffic lights on the road is to safeguard the public's traffic safety.

items.key: ["B2L13-1-03","平板平板電腦","平板（平板電腦）","平板（平板电脑）","N"]

examples.chinese: 這些筆電和平板都比以前的輕。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē bǐdiàn hé píngbǎn dōu bǐ yǐqián de qīng.
examples.english: These laptops and tablets are all lighter than previous ones.

examples.chinese: 我的平板最近不太正常，才用了一個鐘頭就沒電了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de píngbǎn zuìjìn bù tài zhèngcháng, cái yòng le yī ge zhōngtóu jiù méi diàn le.
examples.english: My tablet hasn't been quite normal lately—it ran out of power after only one hour of use.

examples.chinese: 平板越輕、功能越多，價格就越高。
examples.pinyin: Píngbǎn yuè qīng, gōngnéng yuè duō, jiàgé jiù yuè gāo.
examples.english: The lighter the tablet and the more functions it has, the higher the price.

examples.chinese: 我認為跟平板比起來，筆電的功能比較好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ rènwéi gēn píngbǎn bǐ qǐlái, bǐdiàn de gōngnéng bǐjiào hǎo.
examples.english: I think that compared with tablets, laptops have better functions.

examples.chinese: 電腦、手機、平板等等，都是3C產品。
examples.pinyin: Diànnǎo, shǒujī, píngbǎn děngděng, dōu shì 3C chǎnpǐn.
examples.english: Computers, cell phones, tablets, and so on are all 3C products.

examples.chinese: 付錢的時候，他從皮包裡抽出一張信用卡交給店員。他參加百貨公司的活動，抽到一台價格六萬元的平板電腦， 真是太幸運了！
examples.pinyin: Fù qián de shíhou, tā cóng píbāo lǐ chōu chū yī zhāng xìnyòngkǎ jiāo gěi diànyuán. Tā cānjiā bǎihuò gōngsī de huódòng, chōu dào yī tái jiàgé liù wàn yuán de píngbǎn diànnǎo, zhēn shì tài xìngyùn le!
examples.english: When paying, he took out a credit card from his wallet and handed it to the clerk. He participated in a department store event and drew a tablet computer worth 60,000 yuan; he was really so lucky!

examples.chinese: 這個平板的使用說明寫得很詳細，客人自己看就能明白了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège píngbǎn de shǐyòng shuōmíng xiě de hěn xiángxì, kèrén zìjǐ kàn jiù néng míngbai le.
examples.english: The user manual for this tablet is written in great detail; customers can understand it just by reading it themselves.

examples.chinese: 學校書法比賽的獎品是一臺平板電腦，希望能鼓勵大家參加。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào shūfǎ bǐsài de jiǎngpǐn shì yì tái píngbǎn diànnǎo, xīwàng néng gǔlì dàjiā cānjiā.
examples.english: The prize for the school calligraphy competition is a tablet computer, hoping to encourage everyone to participate.

examples.chinese: 那兩個小孩你打我、我推你，不知道在吵什麼？
examples.pinyin: Nà liǎng ge xiǎohái nǐ dǎ wǒ, wǒ tuī nǐ, bù zhīdào zài chǎo shénme?
examples.english: Those two children—you hit me, I push you—I don't know what they are arguing about.

examples.chinese: 小朋友！別吵架、別打架了，有話好好地說。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎopéngyou! Bié chǎojià, bié dǎjià le, yǒu huà hǎohǎo de shuō.
examples.english: Kids! Stop arguing and stop fighting; if you have something to say, say it nicely.

examples.chinese: 小朋友！別吵架、別打架了，有話好好地說。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎopéngyou! Bié chǎojià, bié dǎjià le, yǒu huà hǎohǎo de shuō.
examples.english: Kids! Stop arguing and stop fighting; if you have something to say, say it nicely.

examples.chinese: 那兩個小孩你打我、我推你，不知道在吵什麼？
examples.pinyin: Nà liǎng ge xiǎohái nǐ dǎ wǒ, wǒ tuī nǐ, bù zhīdào zài chǎo shénme?
examples.english: Those two children—you hit me, I push you—I don't know what they are arguing about.

examples.chinese: 王先生跟女朋友吵了一架，現在兩個人不說話了。
examples.pinyin: Wáng xiānsheng gēn nǚpéngyou chǎo le yì jià, xiànzài liǎng ge rén bù shuōhuà le.
examples.english: Mr. Wang had an argument with his girlfriend; now the two of them are not speaking to each other.

examples.chinese: 弟弟半夜在房間聽音樂，聲音很吵。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi bànyè zài fángjiān tīng yīnyuè, shēngyīn hěn chǎo.
examples.english: My little brother listens to music in his room in the middle of the night, and the sound is very noisy.

examples.chinese: 我和姊姊小時候常為了搶玩具吵個沒完，有時候還打架呢。那場演唱會請到了大家最喜愛的明星，所以門票很快就被搶光了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé jiějie xiǎoshíhòu cháng wèile qiǎng wánjù chǎo gè méiwán, yǒu shíhòu hái dǎjià ne. Nà chǎng yǎnchànghuì qǐng dào le dàjiā zuì xǐ'ài de míngxīng, suǒyǐ ménpiào hěn kuài jiù bèi qiǎng guāng le.
examples.english: When my older sister and I were little, we often argued endlessly over competing for toys, and sometimes we even fought. That concert invited everyone's favorite star, so the tickets were quickly snatched up.

examples.chinese: 我昨天親眼看到小史跟人吵架，才知道他罵人的樣子好可怕喔！
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān qīnyǎn kàndào Xiǎo Shǐ gēn rén chǎojià, cái zhīdào tā mà rén de yàngzi hǎo kěpà o!
examples.english: Yesterday I saw with my own eyes Xiao Shi arguing with someone, and only then did I realize how scary he looks when he scolds people!

examples.chinese: A:怎麼回事？外面怎麼這麼吵？ B:鄰居在修理屋頂，快修理好了，你忍耐一下吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Zěnme huí shì? Wàimiàn zěnme zhème chǎo? B: Línjū zài xiūlǐ wūdǐng, kuài xiūlǐ hǎo le, nǐ rěnnài yīxià ba.
examples.english: A: What's the matter? Why is it so noisy outside? B: The neighbor is repairing the roof; it will be fixed soon, so please put up with it for a bit.

examples.chinese: 小連跟老闆吵架而離開了公司，為了讓家人能繼續過安定的生活，他正努力地找新工作。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lián gēn lǎobǎn chǎojià ér líkāi le gōngsī, wèile ràng jiārén néng jìxù guò āndìng de shēnghuó, tā zhèng nǔlì de zhǎo xīn gōngzuò.
examples.english: Xiao Lian left the company after quarreling with the boss; in order to let his family continue to live a safe and stable life, he is working hard to find a new job.

examples.chinese: 張先生夫婦自從結婚以來，不曾吵過架，因為兩人的脾氣都太好了。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng fūfù zìcóng jiéhūn yǐlái, bùcéng chǎo guò jià, yīnwèi liǎng rén de píqi dōu tài hǎo le.
examples.english: Since Mr. and Mrs. Zhang got married, they have never had a fight, because both of their tempers are too good.

examples.chinese: 心裡很平靜(peaceful)的人，就算居住在人車又多又吵的市區，仍然覺得自在。
examples.pinyin: Xīnlǐ hěn píngjìng de rén, jiùsuàn jūzhù zài rén chē yòu duō yòu chǎo de shìqū, réngrán juéde zìzài.
examples.english: People who are very peaceful inside, even if they live in an urban district with many people and cars and lots of noise, still feel at ease.

examples.chinese: 前幾天他們因為一點兒小誤會吵了一架，還好現在和好了。
examples.pinyin: Qián jǐ tiān tāmen yīnwèi yìdiǎnr xiǎo wùhuì chǎo le yí jià, háohǎo xiànzài héhǎo le.
examples.english: A few days ago they had a quarrel because of a small misunderstanding—good thing they've become reconciled now.

examples.chinese: 有些事忍耐一下就過去了，什麼都想以吵架的方式解決，遲早會出事的。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē shì rěnnài yīxià jiù guòqù le, shénme dōu xiǎng yǐ chǎojià de fāngshì jiějué, chízǎo huì chūshì de.
examples.english: Some things pass after enduring them for a bit; if you want to solve everything by arguing, sooner or later there will be an accident.

examples.chinese: 坐火車時，一旁的旅客不停地講電話，吵得我受不了。
examples.pinyin: Zuò huǒchē shí, yīpáng de lǚkè bùtíng de jiǎng diànhuà, chǎo de wǒ shòubuliǎo.
examples.english: When I was on the train, the passenger beside me kept talking on the phone, making such a noise that I couldn't stand it.

examples.chinese: 孩子們好不容易才安靜，別去鬧他們，不然又要開始吵鬧了。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen hǎobùróngyì cái ānjìng, bié qù nào tāmen, bùrán yòu yào kāishǐ chǎonào le.
examples.english: The children have finally quieted down with great difficulty; don't go disturb them, or they will start making noise again.

examples.chinese: 一聽說颱風快來了，許多民眾就去超市搶購蔬菜、水果、泡麵等食物。
examples.pinyin: Yì tīngshuō táifēng kuài lái le, xǔduō mínzhòng jiù qù chāoshì qiǎnggòu shūcài, shuǐguǒ, pàomiàn děng shíwù.
examples.english: As soon as they heard that a typhoon was coming, many people rushed to the supermarket to buy vegetables, fruit, instant noodles, and other foods.

examples.chinese: 想要身體健康，最有效的方法就是多運動、少吃甜點、多吃蔬菜水果。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng yào shēntǐ jiànkāng, zuì yǒuxiào de fāngfǎ jiùshì duō yùndòng, shǎo chī tiándiǎn, duō chī shūcài shuǐguǒ.
examples.english: If you want to be healthy, the most effective way is to exercise more, eat fewer sweets, and eat more vegetables and fruit.

examples.chinese: 那家超市蔬菜水果的種類很多，可提供民眾較多的選擇。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā chāoshì shūcài shuǐguǒ de zhǒnglèi hěn duō, kě tígōng mínzhòng jiào duō de xuǎnzé.
examples.english: That supermarket has many kinds of vegetables and fruits, which can provide people with more choices.

examples.chinese: 奶奶把變黃的蔬菜葉子埋在地裡，讓它變成草地的營養。
examples.pinyin: Nǎinai bǎ biàn huáng de shūcài yèzi mái zài dì lǐ, ràng tā biànchéng cǎodì de yíngyǎng.
examples.english: Grandma buried the yellowed vegetable leaves in the ground, letting them become nutrition for the lawn.

examples.chinese: 奶奶在後院不只種了綠豆及黃豆，還種了許多蔬菜。
examples.pinyin: Nǎinai zài hòuyuàn bùzhǐ zhòng le lǜdòu jí huángdòu, hái zhòng le xǔduō shūcài.
examples.english: Grandma not only planted mung beans and soybeans in the backyard, but also planted many vegetables.

items.wordHook: Combining 蔬(vegetables) and 菜(vegetables): 蔬菜 means vegetable s.

examples.chinese: 大信覺得這個公司的薪水跟福利都不好，於是決定換工作。
examples.pinyin: Dàxìn juéde zhège gōngsī de xīnshuǐ gēn fúlì dōu bù hǎo, yúshì juédìng huàn gōngzuò.
examples.english: Daxin felt that this company's salary and benefits were both bad, so he decided to change jobs.

examples.chinese: 雖然他已經親自說了對不起，但還是很後悔做出那樣沒禮貌的行為，於是再度向各位道歉。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán tā yǐjīng qīnzì shuō le duìbuqǐ, dàn háishì hěn hòuhuǐ zuòchū nàyàng méi lǐmào de xíngwéi, yúshì zàidù xiàng gèwèi dàoqiàn.
examples.english: Although he has already personally said sorry, he still very much regrets having behaved so impolitely, so he once again apologizes to everyone.

examples.chinese: 孫小姐最近談成了幾筆大生意，表現出色，於是公司決定提高她的薪水。
examples.pinyin: Sūn xiǎojiě zuìjìn tán chéng le jǐ bǐ dà shēngyì, biǎoxiàn chūsè, yúshì gōngsī juédìng tígāo tā de xīnshuǐ.
examples.english: Miss Sun recently closed several big deals and her performance was outstanding, so the company decided to raise her salary.

examples.chinese: 公司的待遇不公平，於是他決定辭職。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de dàiyù bù gōngpíng, yúshì tā juédìng cízhí.
examples.english: The company's treatment was unfair, so he decided to resign.

items.key: ["B4L02-1-21","身分證","身分證/身份證","身分证/身份证","N"]

examples.chinese: 身分證是用來證明一個人的身分時使用的。
examples.pinyin: Shēnfènzhèng shì yòng lái zhèngmíng yī ge rén de shēnfèn shí shǐyòng de.
examples.english: An identity card is used when proving a person's identity.

examples.chinese: 去郵局領包裹的時候，記得帶身分證、圖章還有通知單。
examples.pinyin: Qù yóujú lǐng bāoguǒ de shíhou, jìde dài shēnfènzhèng, túzhāng hái yǒu tōngzhīdān.
examples.english: When going to the post office to pick up a parcel, remember to bring your ID card, seal, and notification slip.

examples.chinese: 在自由戀愛的時代中，還是有人透過相親的方式來認識另一半。
examples.pinyin: Zài zìyóu liàn'ài de shídài zhōng, háishì yǒu rén tòuguò xiāngqīn de fāngshì lái rènshi lìng yībàn.
examples.english: In this era of free love, there are still people who get to know their other half through blind dates.

examples.chinese: 戴小姐的父母對婚禮相當重視，連喜帖都是他們親自設計的。
examples.pinyin: Dài xiǎojiě de fùmǔ duì hūnlǐ xiāngdāng zhòngshì, lián xǐtiě dōu shì tāmen qīnzì shèjì de.
examples.english: Miss Dai's parents place great importance on the wedding; even the wedding invitations were designed by them personally.

examples.chinese: 王先生上週向他女友求婚，沒想到才過了幾天就訂婚了。
examples.pinyin: Wáng xiānsheng shàng zhōu xiàng tā nǚyǒu qiúhūn, méi xiǎngdào cái guòle jǐ tiān jiù dìnghūn le.
examples.english: Mr. Wang proposed to his girlfriend last week; unexpectedly, just a few days later they got engaged.

examples.chinese: 錢先生買了一只上百萬的鑽石戒指，當成跟女友求婚的禮物。
examples.pinyin: Qián xiānsheng mǎi le yì zhī shàng bǎi wàn de zuànshí jièzhǐ, dāngchéng gēn nǚyǒu qiúhūn de lǐwù.
examples.english: Mr. Qian bought a diamond ring worth over a million, considering it a gift to propose to his girlfriend.

examples.chinese: 公司不斷推銷新型電子產品，通常是為了刺激客戶購買。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī bùduàn tuīxiāo xīnxíng diànzǐ chǎnpǐn, tōngcháng shì wèile cìjī kèhù gòumǎi.
examples.english: Companies constantly promote new types of electronic products, usually in order to stimulate customers to buy.

examples.chinese: 她在電子工廠上班，難怪拆機器的技術非常熟練。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài diànzǐ gōngchǎng shàngbān, nánguài chāi jīqì de jìshù fēicháng shúliàn.
examples.english: She works at an electronics factory, no wonder her skill in disassembling machines is very proficient.

examples.chinese: 別看張老闆平日吃的、用的都很省，其實他是某家大型電子企業的老闆。
examples.pinyin: Bié kàn Zhāng lǎobǎn píngrì chī de, yòng de dōu hěn shěng, qíshí tā shì mǒu jiā dàxíng diànzǐ qǐyè de lǎobǎn.
examples.english: Don't be fooled by how economical Boss Zhang is in what he eats and uses every day—he's actually the boss of a large electronics company.

examples.chinese: 隨著電子產業發展，人們的生活習慣也受到很深的影響。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe diànzǐ chǎnyè fāzhǎn, rénmen de shēnghuó xíguàn yě shòudào hěn shēn de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: With the development of the electronics industry, people's living habits have also been deeply affected.

examples.chinese: 我們公司在這次電子展共發表了九項新產品，並吸引不少國外客戶來參觀。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī zài zhè cì diànzǐ zhǎn gòng fābiǎo le jiǔ xiàng xīn chǎnpǐn, bìng xīyǐn bù shǎo guówài kèhù lái cānguān.
examples.english: Our company altogether launched nine new products at this electronics exhibition, and attracted many foreign clients to visit.

examples.chinese: 從事電視新聞工作的人有義務傳播正確的消息。
examples.pinyin: Cóngshì diànshì xīnwén gōngzuò de rén yǒu yìwù chuánbō zhèngquè de xiāoxi.
examples.english: People working in television news have an obligation to disseminate correct information.

examples.chinese: 她的物品上都有個小小的蝴蝶標誌，避免別人拿錯。
examples.pinyin: Tā de wùpǐn shàng dōu yǒu ge xiǎoxiǎo de húdié biāozhì, bìmiǎn biérén ná cuò.
examples.english: All her items have a small butterfly mark on them, to avoid others taking them by mistake.

items.wordHook: Combining 因(cause) and 此(this): 因此 means therefore.
桌(table) + 子(noun suffix) → a flat table: 桌子(table).
機(chance) + 會(meeting) → a meeting of timing: 機會 means a chance.
Steps 止(stop) past a guard 戌(halberd), leaving a 𣥂(footprint) as one ages a year: 歲(measure word for age).
牌(sign) + 子(noun suffix): a brand's sign → 子 just makes it a noun.
Possessing 真(real) authenticity in 心(heart): 真心 means wholehearted, sincere.
Combining 題(forehead) and 材(timber): 題材 means theme, subject matter.
